The following events occurred in the year '''3663 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] is hired by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] to protect a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Unidentified Muun ambassador|ambassador]] from the [[GenoHaradan]]. T7 is successful in stopping the assassination, but the assassin managed to escape.<ref name="The Assassination" />
*The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]] [[Death/Legends|kills]] the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[Eckhorn Baliss]] by detonating his ship above [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], staging it as an accident.<ref name="Eckhorn's List">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Eckhorn's List}}</ref>
*[[Mining/Legends|Mining]] operations and [[Ore/Legends|ore]] shipments on [[Ruhnuk]] [[Ruhnuk Mining Disaster|ceased]] with strange [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] completely surrounding the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Ruhnuk">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Ruhnuk}}</ref>
